fact: The tax directorate says its eSINTAX platform, online since April 2018, lets large and mid-size enterprise taxpayers file and pay taxes online.
The tax directorate says eSINTAX lets large and mid-size enterprise taxpayers pay taxes online, and online payment becomes compulsory for large enterprises from 1 January 2020.
The tax directorate says large enterprise taxpayers have been obliged to file returns through the portal since 1 January 2019.
